title: The Ad Hominem Fallacy
skills: define and recognize the ad hominem fallacy
identify when an argument targets a person instead of a claim
distinguish relevant evidence from personal attacks
evaluate arguments for logical relevance, fairness, and sound reasoning
alignment_note: Explains the ad hominem fallacy as a reasoning error in which attention shifts from the argument itself to the person making it. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, rhetorical analysis, critical thinking, civil discourse, and evaluation of argument quality across high school English courses.
